meta_description: Martin Platt Painter & Decorator in Liverpool. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration services. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. We take pride in every finish, on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From interior walls and woodwork to exterior façades and specialist finishes, we handle every painting and decorating job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with premium emulsion, gloss, or specialist finishes. We prep, prime, and paint to a flawless standard—walls, ceilings, doors, and skirting all included.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging on any surface, plus bespoke feature walls to transform your space. We source, fit, and finish with precision seaming and clean edges.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and beautify your home's exterior with hardwearing masonry paint and protective coatings. We handle weathered brickwork, render, fascias, and soffits.

services.title: Woodwork & Door Finishing
services.desc: Expert gloss and satin finishes on doors, windows, frames, and built-in furniture. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for a long-lasting, professional look.

services.title: Artexing & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Ceiling artexing, texture coatings, and bespoke finishes tailored to your taste. From classic to contemporary, we deliver smooth or textured results to order.

services.title: Commercial & Contract Work
services.desc: Large-scale interior and exterior projects for offices, retail units, and rental properties. We work to schedule, minimise disruption, and meet strict project deadlines.

about_pullquote: I turn tired rooms into spaces people actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: Martin Platt has been painting and decorating homes across Liverpool for over two decades. Starting as a one-man operation, the business has built a solid reputation for meticulous preparation, quality materials, and finishes that last. Every project—whether a single bedroom or a whole-house redecoration—receives the same level of attention and professional care.
about_para_2: Customers choose Martin because he listens to what they want, explains options clearly, and delivers on time without hidden costs. Repeat business and word-of-mouth referrals are the backbone of the company. He's known for turning up when promised, leaving sites clean, and standing behind his work with a straightforward guarantee.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Martin

reviews.text: Martin came in to paint our lounge and hallway. Brilliant job—walls are perfectly smooth, no drips, no mess left behind. He's tidy, professional, and didn't fuss about moving furniture. Honestly one of the best tradesmen I've dealt with. Would have him back in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had Martin decorate two bedrooms and the landing. He was really patient when we kept changing our minds about colour. The finish is immaculate—you can barely see the joints on the walls. Fair price too, and he left everything spotless. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Needed our external walls painted before winter. Martin sorted it quickly and used top-quality weatherproof paint. The whole house looks smart again. He knows his stuff and doesn't cut corners. Best decision we made.
reviews.author: Paul T.
